svg.text: Local-minimum trapping in the L. Bombelli & D. Meyer annealer
Each line is one seed on inputs/tesis_like_12.in, dim=3.
Positive final energy means the optimizer froze in a nonzero basin; zero energy means a faithful embedding was found.

Resource context: this is about computational budget, not lack of insight
2026 run here: 64 anneals in 34.0 s (1.88/s) on Linux 6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2, 28 logical CPUs.
CPU label: x86_64. 1987-era context: one workstation and a few costly runs, not cheap seed ensembles.
